# Country scope. One civilian factory with its own new building slot in the capital state.
COLDWAR_EC_build_civ = {
	capital_scope = {
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
	}
}

# Country scope. One level of infrastructure in a state that can take it.
COLDWAR_EC_build_infra = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_state = { is_controlled_by = PREV infrastructure < 5 } }
		random_owned_controlled_state = {
			limit = { infrastructure < 5 }
			add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Trans-European Networks: the requester and the two members with the lowest GDP per head.
COLDWAR_EC_pick_ten_hosts = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_h2 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_h3 = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_b = 999999 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_ctx_by } }
					check_variable = { gdp_per_capita < cwec_t_b } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_b = gdp_per_capita }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_h2 = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_b = 999999 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwec_ctx_by } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { THIS.id = cwec_t_h2 } }
					check_variable = { gdp_per_capita < cwec_t_b } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_b = gdp_per_capita }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_h3 = THIS.id }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Project place 1 finished: buildings, host bonus, Community bonus.
COLDWAR_EC_p1_complete = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = global.cwec_p1_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target = global.cwec_p1_host }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 12 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_item = 101 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_host > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_p1_host = { exists = yes  } }
				var:global.cwec_p1_host = {
					COLDWAR_EC_build_infra = yes
					COLDWAR_EC_build_infra = yes
					COLDWAR_EC_build_civ = yes
					set_temp_variable = { debt_change = gdp_total }
					multiply_temp_variable = { debt_change = 0.003 }
					modify_debt_effect = yes
					COLDWAR_EC_refresh_country = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_HM = 0.01 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_item = 102 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_host > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_p1_host = { exists = yes  } }
				var:global.cwec_p1_host = {
					add_to_variable = { cwec_m_FO = 0.03 }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_m_REA = 0.1 }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_m_BK = 0.02 }
					COLDWAR_EC_refresh_country = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_FO = 0.01 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_item = 103 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_host > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_p1_host = { exists = yes  } }
				var:global.cwec_p1_host = {
					add_to_variable = { cwec_m_FO = 0.04 }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_m_NUC = 0.01 }
					COLDWAR_EC_refresh_country = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_FO = 0.01 }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_P3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_item = 104 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_host > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_p1_host = { exists = yes  } }
				var:global.cwec_p1_host = {
					COLDWAR_EC_build_civ = yes
					COLDWAR_EC_refresh_country = yes
				}
			}
		}
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_run_airbus
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_airbus } add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_EC_P4_tt bonus = 0.5 uses = 2 category = CAT_aircraft } }
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_P4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_item = 105 } }

		54 = {

		}
		15 = {
			if = { limit = { is_owned_by = ENG infrastructure < 5 } add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes } }

			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_host > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_p1_host = { exists = yes  } }
				var:global.cwec_p1_host = {
					COLDWAR_EC_build_civ = yes
					COLDWAR_EC_build_civ = yes
					COLDWAR_EC_build_infra = yes
					COLDWAR_EC_refresh_country = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_ST = 0.01 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_item = 108 } }

		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_c_FO = 0.01 }
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_run_ariane
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ariane } add_tech_bonus = { name = COLDWAR_EC_P8_tt bonus = 0.5 uses = 2 category = CAT_space } }
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_P8
	}
	subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_proj_annual = global.cwec_p1_annual }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_proj_annual min = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_host > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_p1_host = { exists = yes  } }
			var:global.cwec_p1_host = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_p1_annual }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = 0.2 }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwec_host_extra = cwec_t_x }
				clamp_variable = { var = cwec_host_extra min = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_item = global.cwec_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_res = 12 } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.5 } }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_p1_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_p1_host = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_p1_host2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_p1_host3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_p1_start = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_p1_end = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_p1_annual = 0 }
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly completion check of the joint projects.
COLDWAR_EC_projects_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_item > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_p1_end } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_p1_complete = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p2_item > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_p2_end } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_p2_complete = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p3_item > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_p3_end } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_p3_complete = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (recipient). temp cwec_t_eff: effect factor E as in the Cold War code; the Communities count as a Western donor.
COLDWAR_EC_calc_eff = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_eff = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_3_dynamic_modifier } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_eff = 1.25 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_1_dynamic_modifier } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_eff = 0.6 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_mod = 1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_mod = modifier@mdcw_cw_assistance_effectiveness }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_mod min = 0 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_eff = cwec_t_mod }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_gpc }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_eff = 1.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_eff = 1.25 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_1 } multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_eff = global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 1 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_eff = 0.75 }
	}
}

# Country scope, called inside mdcw_cw_recalculate_country before the receiver caps: Community programmes add to the received values (same caps as all programmes).
COLDWAR_EC_cw_receiver = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_aid_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target = THIS.id } }
			COLDWAR_EC_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = global.cwec_h1_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = cwec_t_eff }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_construction = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.06 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_research = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_productivity = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.1 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_growth = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_max = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_pp = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy = cwec_t_v }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target = THIS.id } }
			COLDWAR_EC_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = global.cwec_h2_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = cwec_t_eff }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_construction = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.06 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_research = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_productivity = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.1 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_growth = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_max = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_pp = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy = cwec_t_v }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target = THIS.id } }
			COLDWAR_EC_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = global.cwec_h3_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_sf = cwec_t_eff }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_construction = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.06 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_research = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_productivity = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.1 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_growth = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_max = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_pp = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy = cwec_t_v }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (recipient). temp cwec_t_mult 5 or 15: the Soviet Union resents a Western programme, scaled by the power rank of the recipient (11.2).
COLDWAR_EC_sov_reaction = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = super_power }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_w = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = great_power }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_w = 1.6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = large_power }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_w = 1.3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = regional_power }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_w = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = minor_power }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_w = 0.7 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_w = 0.5 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_op = cwec_t_w }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_op = cwec_t_mult }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV
			NOT = { tag = SOV } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_op > 27.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_sov_aid_30 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_op > 22.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_sov_aid_25 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_op > 17.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_sov_aid_20 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_op > 12.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_sov_aid_15 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_op > 9 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_sov_aid_10 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_op > 7.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_sov_aid_8 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_op > 6 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_sov_aid_7 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_op > 4.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_sov_aid_5 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_op > 3.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_sov_aid_4 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_op > 0 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					SOV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_sov_aid_3 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The recipient accepted: a Community assistance programme starts for two years.
COLDWAR_EC_start_aid = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_done = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_done = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_done = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_h = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = global.cwec_ctx_opt }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_size = global.cwec_ctx_size }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_ret = global.cwec_ctx_ret }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_start = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_h1_end = 730 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_remit = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_done = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_done = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_h = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = global.cwec_ctx_opt }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_size = global.cwec_ctx_size }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_ret = global.cwec_ctx_ret }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_start = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_h2_end = 730 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_remit = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwec_t_done = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_done = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_h = 3 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target = global.cwec_ctx_target }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = global.cwec_ctx_opt }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_size = global.cwec_ctx_size }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_ret = global.cwec_ctx_ret }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_by = global.cwec_ctx_by }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_start = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_h3_end = 730 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_remit = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_done = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 13 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
				var:global.cwec_ctx_by = {
					set_variable = { cwec_ev6_item = 120 } set_variable = { cwec_ev6_res = 13 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_done = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes  } }
				var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_aid_recipient
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwec_ext value = THIS } } }
						add_to_array = { global.cwec_ext = THIS }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# one-off consequences of the chosen return
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ret = 3 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -1 }
					COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ret = 4 } }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
				COLDWAR_EC_reform_gap = yes
				set_variable = { cwec_reform_until = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_reform_until = 365 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = cwec_t_gap }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = global.cwec_ctx_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = 0.5 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_ret = 5 } }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_size = 1 } }
						for_each_scope_loop = {
							array = global.cwec_members
							if = {
								limit = { exists = yes }
								PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_aid_partner_1 } }
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_size = 2 } }
						for_each_scope_loop = {
							array = global.cwec_members
							if = {
								limit = { exists = yes }
								PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_aid_partner_2 } }
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_size = 3 } }
						for_each_scope_loop = {
							array = global.cwec_members
							if = {
								limit = { exists = yes }
								PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_aid_partner_3 } }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 1 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
						set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 }
						mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_mult = 15 }
				}
				else = {
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_mult = 5 }
				}
				COLDWAR_EC_sov_reaction = yes
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_update_shared_capacity = yes
		COLDWAR_EC_aid_recompute = yes
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
		COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes  } }
				var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
					if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = no }
						set_variable = { cwec_ev8_item = 120 } set_variable = { cwec_ev8_res = 14 } set_variable = { cwec_ev8_target = THIS.id } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.8 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_res = 14 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_item = 120 } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_res = 14 } set_variable = { cwec_ev5_target = global.cwec_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.5 } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. temp cwec_t_gap: distance to the democratic clause (0.5 democracy, 1 authoritarian, 1.5 communist).
COLDWAR_EC_reform_gap = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_EC_democratic_clause = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gap = 0.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_communist_government = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gap = 1.5 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gap = 1 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Community programme 1 ends after two years; the shared capacity returns.
COLDWAR_EC_h1_end = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target = global.cwec_h1_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = 120 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_tg = global.cwec_h1_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_start = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_end = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_remit = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes  } }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target = THIS.id } } }
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_aid_recipient
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					set_variable = { cwec_ev8_item = 120 } set_variable = { cwec_ev8_res = 15 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.8 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_update_shared_capacity = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_aid_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
				mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Community programme 2 ends after two years; the shared capacity returns.
COLDWAR_EC_h2_end = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target = global.cwec_h2_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = 120 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_tg = global.cwec_h2_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_start = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_end = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_remit = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes  } }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target = THIS.id } } }
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_aid_recipient
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					set_variable = { cwec_ev8_item = 120 } set_variable = { cwec_ev8_res = 15 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.8 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_update_shared_capacity = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_aid_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
				mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Community programme 3 ends after two years; the shared capacity returns.
COLDWAR_EC_h3_end = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target = global.cwec_h3_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_item = 120 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_tg = global.cwec_h3_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_start = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_end = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_remit = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes  } }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target = THIS.id } } }
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_aid_recipient
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					set_variable = { cwec_ev8_item = 120 } set_variable = { cwec_ev8_res = 15 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.8 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_update_shared_capacity = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_aid_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_ctx_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_ctx_target = { exists = yes has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } }
			var:global.cwec_ctx_target = {
				mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly end of Community programmes.
COLDWAR_EC_aid_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target > 0 }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_h1_end } }
				NOT = { var:global.cwec_h1_target = { exists = yes } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_EC_h1_end = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target > 0 }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_h2_end } }
				NOT = { var:global.cwec_h2_target = { exists = yes } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_EC_h2_end = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target > 0 }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_h3_end } }
				NOT = { var:global.cwec_h3_target = { exists = yes } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_EC_h3_end = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Monthly (and on every change): cost, recipient lines and the dynamic return of every running Community programme from the real values of the recipient (11.2).
COLDWAR_EC_aid_recompute = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_HM = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_ZS = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_OR = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_IND = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_MIL = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_KG = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_AS = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_AP = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_ZP = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_PW = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_FO = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_ZI = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_ST = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_PP = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_BK = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_SK = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_WE = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_IB = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_AK = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_DD = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_GL = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_POL = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_REA = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_NUC = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwec_aidw_AK = 0 }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_aid_workers_host
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_ext
		set_variable = { cwec_x_HM = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_x_ZS = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_x_AP = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_x_GL = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_x_ST = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_x_DD = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_x_REX = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_x_RGDP = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_x_AK = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_x_POP = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_x_OR = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aid_cost_month = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwec_h1_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwec_h1_target = {
			COLDWAR_EC_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_S = global.cwec_h1_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_S = 0.5 }
			# monthly cost from the Community budget (Eastern recipients x1.5)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = cwec_t_S }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 1.5 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aid_cost_month = cwec_t_c }
			# own Community lines on the recipient (agriculture, democracy)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_AP = cwec_t_v }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_DD = cwec_t_v }
			}
			# the return (11.2), read from the recipient every month
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_ret = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_M = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_M = 50 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_M min = 0.2 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 50 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = globalism_value }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 100 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 1 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_O min = 0.5 max = 1.5 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.015 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_v max = 0.03 }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_HM = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.005 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_ZS = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 5 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_O }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_GL = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_O }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ZS = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_HM = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_ret = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@oil }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@oil }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@steel }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@steel }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 2 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@aluminium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@aluminium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@chromium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@chromium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@tungsten }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@tungsten }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@rubber }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@rubber }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_V > 4.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_R = cwec_t_V }
					divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_R = 20 }
					clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_R min = 0.25 max = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_RS = cwec_t_R }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_RS = cwec_t_S }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.04 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_v max = 0.1 }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_OR = cwec_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_IND = cwec_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_MIL = cwec_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.005 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_KG = cwec_t_v }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.08 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_REX = cwec_t_v }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_RGDP = cwec_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_ret = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_U = total_unemployed_percentage_display }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_U = 0.08 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_U min = 0.25 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_US = cwec_t_U }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_US = cwec_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ST = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_US }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_POP = cwec_t_v }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_remit = cwec_t_US }
				multiply_variable = { global.cwec_h1_remit = 0.1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_by > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { var:global.cwec_h1_by = { exists = yes  } }
						var:global.cwec_h1_by = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.005 }
							multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_US }
							add_to_variable = { cwec_aidw_AK = cwec_t_v }
							set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_aid_workers_host
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_ret = 4 } }
				COLDWAR_EC_reform_gap = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_GS = cwec_t_gap }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_GS = cwec_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_GS }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_DD = cwec_t_v }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_reform_until } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.02 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_GS }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ST = cwec_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_ret = 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0.25 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 1 } }
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0.15 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ST = cwec_t_v }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwec_h2_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwec_h2_target = {
			COLDWAR_EC_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_S = global.cwec_h2_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_S = 0.5 }
			# monthly cost from the Community budget (Eastern recipients x1.5)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = cwec_t_S }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 1.5 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aid_cost_month = cwec_t_c }
			# own Community lines on the recipient (agriculture, democracy)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_AP = cwec_t_v }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_DD = cwec_t_v }
			}
			# the return (11.2), read from the recipient every month
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_ret = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_M = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_M = 50 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_M min = 0.2 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 50 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = globalism_value }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 100 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 1 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_O min = 0.5 max = 1.5 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.015 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_v max = 0.03 }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_HM = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.005 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_ZS = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 5 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_O }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_GL = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_O }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ZS = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_HM = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_ret = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@oil }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@oil }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@steel }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@steel }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 2 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@aluminium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@aluminium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@chromium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@chromium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@tungsten }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@tungsten }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@rubber }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@rubber }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_V > 4.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_R = cwec_t_V }
					divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_R = 20 }
					clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_R min = 0.25 max = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_RS = cwec_t_R }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_RS = cwec_t_S }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.04 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_v max = 0.1 }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_OR = cwec_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_IND = cwec_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_MIL = cwec_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.005 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_KG = cwec_t_v }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.08 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_REX = cwec_t_v }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_RGDP = cwec_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_ret = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_U = total_unemployed_percentage_display }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_U = 0.08 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_U min = 0.25 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_US = cwec_t_U }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_US = cwec_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ST = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_US }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_POP = cwec_t_v }
				set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_remit = cwec_t_US }
				multiply_variable = { global.cwec_h2_remit = 0.1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_by > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { var:global.cwec_h2_by = { exists = yes  } }
						var:global.cwec_h2_by = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.005 }
							multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_US }
							add_to_variable = { cwec_aidw_AK = cwec_t_v }
							set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_aid_workers_host
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_ret = 4 } }
				COLDWAR_EC_reform_gap = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_GS = cwec_t_gap }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_GS = cwec_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_GS }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_DD = cwec_t_v }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_reform_until } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.02 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_GS }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ST = cwec_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_ret = 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0.25 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 1 } }
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0.15 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ST = cwec_t_v }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwec_h3_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwec_h3_target = {
			COLDWAR_EC_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_S = global.cwec_h3_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_S = 0.5 }
			# monthly cost from the Community budget (Eastern recipients x1.5)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = cwec_t_S }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 1.5 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aid_cost_month = cwec_t_c }
			# own Community lines on the recipient (agriculture, democracy)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_AP = cwec_t_v }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_DD = cwec_t_v }
			}
			# the return (11.2), read from the recipient every month
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_ret = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_M = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_M = 50 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_M min = 0.2 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 50 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = globalism_value }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 100 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 1 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_O min = 0.5 max = 1.5 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.015 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_v max = 0.03 }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_HM = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.005 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_ZS = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 5 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_O }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_GL = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_O }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ZS = cwec_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_HM = cwec_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_ret = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@oil }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@oil }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@steel }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@steel }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 2 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@aluminium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@aluminium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@chromium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@chromium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@tungsten }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@tungsten }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@rubber }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@rubber }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_V > 4.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_R = cwec_t_V }
					divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_R = 20 }
					clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_R min = 0.25 max = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_RS = cwec_t_R }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_RS = cwec_t_S }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.04 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_v max = 0.1 }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_OR = cwec_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_IND = cwec_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_MIL = cwec_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.005 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_aidret_KG = cwec_t_v }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.08 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_REX = cwec_t_v }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_RS }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_RGDP = cwec_t_v }

			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_ret = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_U = total_unemployed_percentage_display }
