				multiply_variable = { global.cwec_h3_remit = 0.1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_by > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { var:global.cwec_h3_by = { exists = yes  } }
						var:global.cwec_h3_by = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.005 }
							multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_US }
							add_to_variable = { cwec_aidw_AK = cwec_t_v }
							set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_aid_workers_host
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_ret = 4 } }
				COLDWAR_EC_reform_gap = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_GS = cwec_t_gap }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_GS = cwec_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_GS }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_x_DD = cwec_t_v }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_reform_until } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = -0.02 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_GS }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ST = cwec_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_ret = 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0.25 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 1 } }
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0.15 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { cwec_west_disc = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_v = cwec_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_x_ST = cwec_t_v }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_aidret_HM max = 0.06 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_aidret_OR max = 0.15 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_ext
		COLDWAR_EC_refresh_external_country = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. The Community modifier of a partner country (programmes received and what it gives in return).
COLDWAR_EC_refresh_external_country = {
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_x_AP max = 0.12 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_aid_recipient COLDWAR_EC_is_associate = yes } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_external } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_external } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_external } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_external } }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Any scope. Refreshes every partner country.
COLDWAR_EC_refresh_external = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_ext
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } COLDWAR_EC_refresh_external_country = yes }
	}
}

# Any scope. While Community programmes run, every member loses Cold War assistance capacity: -1 for a small or medium, -2 for a large programme, at most -3 (11.3). A member over its limit gets seven days to end a programme itself.
COLDWAR_EC_update_shared_capacity = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_m max = 3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_aidcap_malus = cwec_t_m }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_aidcap_malus = -1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			COLDWAR_EC_refresh_country = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
				mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_overcap } }
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_overcap
					set_variable = { cwec_overcap_due = global.num_days }
					add_to_variable = { cwec_overcap_due = 7 }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwec_overcap value = THIS } } }
						add_to_array = { global.cwec_overcap = THIS }
					}
					COLDWAR_EC_find_newest = yes
					set_variable = { cwec_pv_type = cwec_t_bestn }
					set_variable = { cwec_pv_partner = cwec_t_bestc }
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = no }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.15 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (donor). temp cwec_t_bestc/cwec_t_bestn: the own Cold War programme that ends last (the newest), type 1-8 or 9 = public support.
COLDWAR_EC_find_newest = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mdcw_cw_out
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_end@THIS > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_end@THIS > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_end@THIS > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_end@THIS > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_end@THIS > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_end@THIS > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_end@THIS > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_end@THIS > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_party@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_end@THIS > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 9 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (donor over its limit). Ends the newest own programme through the Cold War end effects; the recipient gets the usual notice.
COLDWAR_EC_end_newest = {
	COLDWAR_EC_find_newest = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestc > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwec_ended_type = cwec_t_bestn }
		set_variable = { cwec_ended_partner = cwec_t_bestc }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 0 }
		var:cwec_t_bestc = {
			PREV = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 1 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_1 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 2 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_2 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 3 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_3 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 4 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_4 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 5 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_5 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 6 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_6 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 7 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_7 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 8 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_8 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestn = 9 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_pps = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.16 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. After seven days: end the newest programmes until the capacity is no longer exceeded.
COLDWAR_EC_overcap_resolve = {
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_end_newest = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_end_newest = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_end_newest = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_end_newest = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_end_newest = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	}
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_overcap
}

# Any scope. Weekly check of members over their assistance capacity.
COLDWAR_EC_overcap_tick = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_overcap
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = yes } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_overcap
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_overcap
		}
		else = {
			mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free > -0.5 } }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_overcap
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_overcap_due } } }
				COLDWAR_EC_overcap_resolve = yes
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_overcap
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_overcap } } add_to_temp_array = { cwec_t_clear = THIS } }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwec_t_clear
		remove_from_array = { global.cwec_overcap = THIS }
	}
}

# Any scope. Preview for the vote: assistance capacity of every player member now and after the programme in global.cwec_ui_size, and which own programme would end.
COLDWAR_EC_capacity_preview = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_m max = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_add = global.cwec_ui_size }
	COLDWAR_EC_size_to_malus = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ui_capk = cwec_t_addm }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = cwec_t_addm }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_m max = 3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ui_capnew = cwec_t_m }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_ui_capnew = -1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { cwec_pv_now = mdcw_cw_cap_max }
				set_variable = { cwec_pv_used = mdcw_cw_cap_used }
				set_variable = { cwec_pv_after = mdcw_cw_cap_max }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwec_pv_after = cwec_aidcap }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_pv_after = global.cwec_ui_capnew }
				set_variable = { cwec_pv_type = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwec_pv_partner = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_pv_used > cwec_pv_after }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
					COLDWAR_EC_find_newest = yes
					set_variable = { cwec_pv_type = cwec_t_bestn }
					set_variable = { cwec_pv_partner = cwec_t_bestc }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_addm: capacity loss of a programme of size cwec_t_add.
COLDWAR_EC_size_to_malus = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_add = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_addm = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_add > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_addm = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_addm = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly: projects, programmes, loans and members over their capacity.
COLDWAR_EC_programmes_tick = {
	COLDWAR_EC_projects_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_aid_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_loans_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_overcap_tick = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_budget_dirty }
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_budget_dirty
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Monthly: frozen associates and applications from national focus trees; only a fixed list of European countries is read.
COLDWAR_EC_neighbours_month = {
	# associates: the democratic clause freezes and thaws the association (Greece 1967-1974)
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_watch
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes
				COLDWAR_EC_is_associate = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_frozen
					COLDWAR_EC_democratic_clause = yes }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_frozen
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_associate } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_associate }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_frozen }
					NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_democratic_clause = yes } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_frozen
				if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_associate } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_associate }
			}
		}
	}
	# applications made by other content (flag EU_candidate, e.g. the Spanish tree)
	if = { limit = { country_exists = ENG ENG = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } ENG = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = IRE IRE = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } IRE = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = DEN DEN = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } DEN = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = NRY NRY = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } NRY = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SPR SPR = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } SPR = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = POR POR = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } POR = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = GRE GRE = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } GRE = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = TUR TUR = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } TUR = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = AUS AUS = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } AUS = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SWE SWE = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } SWE = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SWI SWI = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } SWI = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = FIN FIN = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } FIN = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = ICE ICE = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } ICE = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = CYP CYP = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } CYP = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
	if = { limit = { country_exists = MLT MLT = { has_country_flag = EU_candidate COLDWAR_EC_can_apply = yes } } MLT = { COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = yes } }
}

# Country scope. Application under Art. 237 (players by the window; other content by the flag EU_candidate).
COLDWAR_EC_submit_application = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_applicant = yes }
			NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } }
		set_variable = { cwec_status = 2 }
		set_variable = { cwec_applied = global.num_days }
		COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes
		COLDWAR_EC_set_country_data = yes
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev17_target = PREV.id } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.17 } }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_dirty = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. A third country asks the members to table an association agreement (Art. 238).
COLDWAR_EC_request_association = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_associate = yes }
			NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_applicant = yes }
			NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_wants_association days = 365 value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwec_assoc_req value = THIS } } }
			add_to_array = { global.cwec_assoc_req = THIS }
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev18_target = PREV.id } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.18 } }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Court of Justice: a member that sanctions another member (Imperia sanctions) faces an infringement case; judgment after 180 days.
COLDWAR_EC_court_month = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_breach = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { any_of_scopes = {
						array = global.cwec_members
						NOT = { tag = PREV }
						OR = { is_in_array = { array = imp_dip_sanc_on_us value = PREV } is_in_array = { array = imp_fin_sanc_on_us value = PREV } is_in_array = { array = imp_eco_sanc_on_us value = PREV } is_in_array = { array = imp_mil_sanc_on_us value = PREV } }
				} }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_breach = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_infringement }
					check_variable = { cwec_t_breach = 1 } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_infringement
				set_variable = { cwec_case_due = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { cwec_case_due = 180 }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwec_members
					if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev19_target = PREV.id } set_variable = { cwec_ev19_res = 1 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.19 } }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_infringement
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_case_due } } }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_infringement
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_breach = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_z = -3 }
					COLDWAR_EC_add_support = yes
					for_each_scope_loop = {
						array = global.cwec_members
						if = { limit = { NOT = { tag = PREV } } add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_EC_op_court } }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_A9 }
						set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
						multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.0005 }
						modify_treasury_effect = yes
					}
					for_each_scope_loop = {
						array = global.cwec_members
						if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev19_target = PREV.id } set_variable = { cwec_ev19_res = 2 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.19 } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

}

# Any scope. Projects running or on their way (global.cwec_nproj).
COLDWAR_EC_count_projects = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_np = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_item > 100 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_item < 110 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_np = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_item > 100 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_item < 110 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase > 0 } }

# Any scope. Community programmes running or on their way (global.cwec_naid).
COLDWAR_EC_count_aid = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_na = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_item = 120 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_na = 1 }
	}

		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_item = 120 }
